europe_now.title: US Seeks European Representation in Ukraine Peace Talks
europe_now.summary: United States officials have insisted that European nations be given a seat at the table for upcoming negotiations regarding the conflict in Ukraine.

sources.headline: US demands a seat for Europe at Ukraine peace talks

europe_now.title: France Investigates Iranian Cyberattack on Commercial Refrigeration
europe_now.summary: French prosecutors have opened a formal probe into an Iranian cyber unit following a coordinated attack targeting supermarket refrigeration systems across the country.

sources.headline: France blames Iran for cyberattack on supermarket fridges

top_stories.title: Military Exercises and Strategic Defense in Poland
